pilot_requirements: Supply the exact complete OLD and official NEW22 rule texts.
Configure OPENAI_API_KEY as an environment variable in the runner host; do not put it in chat, code, Git, or logs.
Pin BENCHMARK_MODEL_ID to a model snapshot that supports Responses API web_search and configure one BENCHMARK_REASONING_EFFORT for both rules.
Keep temperature and max output tokens fixed for both rules (defaults are BENCHMARK_TEMPERATURE=0.2 and BENCHMARK_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS=2000 unless explicitly set).
Run from a clone/worktree with authenticated Git push and fetch/readback access to the existing origin/main.
